about.title: About Blood Lagbe
about.intro: Blood Lagbe is a centralized blood donation and emergency donor management platform, built to replace scattered Facebook groups, phone calls and outdated donor lists with one organized system.
about.mission: Make finding a suitable blood donor faster, easier and more reliable — especially when time matters most.
about.problem: Fragmented searching, outdated donor information, emergency delays and no centralized tracking make it hard to find the right donor at the right time.
about.solution: A single platform for donor registration, smart search, blood requests, emergency alerts, and hospital/organization management.
